title: The Appointment Booking Plugin WordPress plugin before 5.7.6 does not escape several booking-form step content…
description: The Appointment Booking Plugin for WordPress versions before 5.7.6 contains a vulnerability where several booking-form step content settings are not properly escaped before rendering on the public booking form. This allows high-privilege users, such as administrators, to inject JavaScript that executes in the browsers of visitors who load the form. In multisite environments, this vulnerability crosses a privilege boundary to unauthenticated visitors when administrators lack the unfiltered_html capability.
